parents.subject: Social Work
parents.course: Special Studies in Soc Work I

ns2:section.sectionText: This course will provide a theoretical and practice background on all phases of the social workers response to disasters. Using an experiential approach, students will learn phases of the disaster cycle and how organizations generally respond to these events both nationally and globally. Students also have the opportunity to participate in online trainings through the National Child Traumatic Stress Networks "Psychological First Aid" and "Skills for Psychological Recovery" to understand how to support individuals in a crisis scenario.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to MSW:Social Work -UIUC or MSW:Social Work -UIUC.
